reviewed.note: manifest_version 3, module service worker, strict extension_pages CSP (script-src 'self'), minimum_chrome_version 116, lint enforces allowlist.
activeTab+scripting+storage+identity, host_permissions empty. Sufficient for captureVisibleTab/executeScript after an action click and for launchWebAuthFlow.

No Chrome-only API beyond identity/tabs/scripting; Edge detected by UA. Real Chrome AND Edge acceptance recorded NOT EXECUTED/DEFERRED; the e2e harness bypasses the popup (see UC-EXT-001) so it could never have caught the popup defect.

Injected on demand (no static content_scripts). Re-injected on every capture, so each capture on the same page adds another onMessage listener (duplicate DOM serialisation work); functionally harmless.
Workspace list reads a field the API does not return (UC-EXT-001); load errors rendered as empty (UC-EXT-002).
S256 verifier/challenge, random state checked, code exchanged with verifier, token in chrome.storage.session.

Single-use hashed 60s code, atomic claim, client+redirect+PKCE binding all correct. Authorize has no sign-in bridge (UC-EXT-006). Token hard-codes authMethod SOCIAL_OAUTH regardless of how the user authenticated (extension-oauth.routes.ts:351) - provenance label only, noted not filed.

Unset/invalid env => explicit list empty => every redirect refused. ET-DC-04 remediation holds. Not present in any .env.example; release checklist carries it (docs/admin/EXTENSION_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md:68-71).
Deny-by-default route-pattern allowlist; presign limited to the ACTIVE extension session's own record (extension-scope.ts:209-223).
See UC-EXT-001: list always empty, capture disabled.

reviewed.topic: Case selection / add to existing case
reviewed.note: No case field in popup, open-session body has no caseId (.strict()), and the scoped token cannot reach /v1/cases/*. Filing to a case is only possible later in the web app. UC-EXT-010.
open -> reserve -> per-part presign/PUT/declare -> manifest part -> web-complete; server validates manifest, ties it to a declared digest, 1:1 artifact<->part cross-check, recomputes digests at seal.

No cancel control; /discard route is on the scope allowlist but never called. Abandoned reservations rely on the worker reservation sweep (ET-DC-05 remediation, services/worker/src/capture-reaper.ts).
No step-level retry; any failure fails the whole capture and the user re-clicks, which opens a brand-new session/record.
Network error surfaces as the generic line 'Nothing was saved'. That line is false if the drop happens after web-complete sealed server-side (response lost) - covered by UC-EXT-005.
1h token, 'offline' scope requested but no refresh token issued or used; expiry mid-session shows the generic capture failure, not a sign-in prompt. UC-EXT-008.
Guard lives only in popup DOM state; see UC-EXT-005.

Token in storage.session (cleared on browser restart => re-sign-in, by design). No in-flight capture state is persisted anywhere; a SW/browser termination mid-capture is unrecoverable and unreported; server session expires and reservation is swept.
Progress only reaches an open popup; closing the popup loses the outcome entirely. Known denial codes mapped truthfully (apps/extension/src/lib/denial-copy.ts:23-62).
Sign-out only deletes the local copy; no server revocation endpoint, token carries no sid so per-session revocation cannot target it; stays valid up to 1h. UC-EXT-009.
Scripts/handlers/javascript: URLs/refresh/base removed and secret-named inputs cleared, but <meta name=csrf-token content=...> and similar are kept. UC-EXT-007.
Manifest completeness/limitations are validated then never read by any API/worker/web consumer. UC-EXT-004.
Entirely generic; no product copy claims platform-specific capture. See facts.siteSpecific.

Local build defaults to http://localhost:4000 (never production). Release refuses missing/non-https/localhost PROOVRA_API_ORIGIN and scans the bundle for localhost. Gap (P3, not filed): PROOVRA_AUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL/PROOVRA_AUTH_TOKEN_URL overrides are not https-checked, only localhost-scanned.
No install link unless a validated store URL exists (extension unpublished => 'has not been published yet'). Copy overclaim filed as UC-EXT-011.
Works through canonical POST /v1/evidence + /parts + /complete. Drop path puts a raw browser exception message on screen (UC-WEB-006).
No browser screen capture on web/PWA; web capture of a page is extension-only.
getUserMedia with unsupported/denied states; recorded as PROOVRA_WEB_UPLOAD (truthful, services/api/src/routes/evidence.routes.ts create path). No pause/resume of recording.
Per-part retry keeps the same index (ET-INT-02 holds). Reload loses the session (UC-WEB-003). No beforeunload guard.

An EvidenceRequest is a reviewer-side request that mints an intake link for an external contributor (deliverables checklist, responses, re-request). Only the [id] inspector exists; Home CTA links to the missing list page (UC-WEB-004).
Capture never takes a case; filing is a later bulk action on the Evidence library.
Full multipart+IndexedDB recovery engine exists but is gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_RESUMABLE_UPLOADS_ENABLED (default off); production path is single presigned PUT per file with 3 transient retries.
No service worker; no offline capture queue on the default path.
Single 469x529 non-square PNG declared sizes 'any' purpose 'any maskable'; no 192/512 icons. Installability in Chromium not assured and maskable crop will distort. P3, not filed separately.

Capture uses /v1/evidence, /parts, /complete; intake uses external-intake routes that write parts through the one writeEvidencePart authority (services/api/src/services/external-intake-orchestration.service.ts:568-596).

findings.title: Extension popup reads `workspaces`/`teams` from /v1/platform/context, which returns neither, so the workspace list is always empty and both Capture buttons are disabled
findings.userImpact: A signed-in user can never start a Direct Web Capture from the popup: the select shows 'No workspace available' and busy(true) disables both capture buttons. The UC-1 channel is unusable end to end.
findings.legalImpact: No web-capture evidence can be produced through the product surface.
findings.reproduction: Sign in via the popup. render() -> loadWorkspaces() GETs /v1/platform/context; the route sends result.envelope (PlatformContextEnvelope). The envelope's workspace list is `availableWorkspaces` (types.ts:1097, {id,name,scope,role}) plus `contextOptions`/`organizations`; it has no top-level `workspaces` or `teams`. popup.ts:32 `body.workspaces ?? body.teams ?? []` => [] => popup.ts:138-143 renders 'No workspace available' and busy(true).
findings.observed: Workspace list always empty; capture disabled for every user.
findings.expected: The popup lists the user's capture-eligible workspaces from the canonical envelope field.
findings.rootCause: Popup parses an invented envelope key. The acceptance spec never opens the popup: it writes the token into storage and sends PRESERVE with PROOVRA_E2E_TEAM_ID directly from the service worker (direct-web-capture.spec.ts:409-449), so the defect is structurally invisible to every existing test.
findings.remediation: Read the canonical workspace options (availableWorkspaces or contextOptions via the shared projection), filtered to workspaces where evidence.create is permitted; add a contract test in tools/contract-audit style that the popup's parsed keys exist in PlatformContextEnvelope.
findings.requiredTests: Popup unit test against a recorded /v1/platform/context envelope; e2e that drives the real popup (click action, choose workspace, click Capture).
findings.runtimeProbe: Against a disposable API: mint an extension token via /v1/oauth/extension/*, GET /v1/platform/context with it, assert Object.keys(body) contains neither 'workspaces' nor 'teams'.

findings.title: Popup turns an expired/revoked token or any API failure on the workspace load into 'No workspace available' instead of a sign-in or error state
findings.userImpact: A 401/403/5xx/network failure is shown as a healthy empty state; the user is told they have no workspace and is never prompted to sign in again.
findings.reproduction: With a stored token that the server rejects (revoked, iat before a revoke-all, or user deleted), open the popup: loadWorkspaces returns [] on !res.ok (line 30) and on throw (33-35); render shows 'No workspace available'.
findings.expected: 401 clears the token and shows the signed-out section; other failures show a factual 'could not load workspaces' line with retry.
findings.rootCause: loadWorkspaces collapses every non-OK outcome to an empty array.
findings.remediation: Return a discriminated result; on 401 call clearToken() and re-render signed-out; otherwise show an error state.
findings.requiredTests: Popup test for 401, 500 and network error on /v1/platform/context.

findings.title: Full-page capture calls captureVisibleTab roughly every 250ms+capture time, above Chrome's 2-calls-per-second quota; the quota error aborts the whole capture
findings.userImpact: 'Capture full page' likely fails with the generic error on any page taller than about two viewports; nothing is preserved (no partial fallback).
findings.legalImpact: Full-page preservation, the mode most relevant to long posts/threads, cannot complete.
findings.reproduction: captureFullPage loop: SCROLL_TO message, setTimeout(tileSettleMs=250), captureVisibleTab, sha256 -> next tile. Iteration period is ~250ms plus capture/hash time (typically well under 1s), so tiles 1-3 fall inside one second. chrome.tabs.MAX_CAPTURE_VISIBLE_TAB_CALLS_PER_SECOND is 2; the third call rejects, the exception propagates out of captureFullPage and runPreserve, and the popup shows CAPTURE_FAILED.
findings.observed: No rate pacing against the documented quota; no catch around captureVisibleTab; no partial manifest on tile failure.
findings.expected: Pace tiles to >=500ms apart (or retry on the quota error with backoff) and, if a tile still fails, finish as PARTIAL with CAPTURE_INTERRUPTED rather than discarding everything.
findings.rootCause: Tile timing chosen for lazy-load settling only, ignoring the platform capture quota; real-browser acceptance never passed (UC1 doc §K), so it was never observed.
findings.remediation: Enforce a minimum interval between captureVisibleTab calls; wrap in retry-on-quota; on persistent failure truncate tiles and mark PARTIAL.
findings.requiredTests: Unit test of the pacing scheduler; real-Chrome e2e on apps/extension/e2e/fixtures/long.html with >=6 viewports.
findings.runtimeProbe: Load the unpacked extension in Chrome stable, open a 10-viewport page, click the action, 'Capture full page'; inspect the service-worker console for 'exceeds the MAX_CAPTURE_VISIBLE_TAB_CALLS_PER_SECOND quota'. Source is the code path; the quota constant is Chrome's documented value, runtime confirmation still required.

findings.title: Per-capture completeness and limitation codes in the web manifest are never shown on any surface, and several are never emitted or never downgrade completeness
findings.userImpact: A truncated, interrupted, mutated, shadow-DOM or iframe-incomplete capture looks identical in Detail/Report/Package summary to a complete one; reviewers only see the mode-generic limitation text.
findings.legalImpact: The acquisition statement promises 'PROOVRA records the representation it received and any limitations it detected', but the detected limitations are buried in a raw JSON part. A PARTIAL capture can be presented as a complete record of the page.
findings.reproduction: (a) grep sourceUrlPrivate|pageMutatedDuringCapture|WEB_CAPTURE limitation codes across services/api/src, services/worker/src, apps/web: only the validator and web-capture.service read the manifest; the package/report limitations come from resolveEvidenceAcquisition (static per mode). (b) deriveCompleteness (manifest-builder.ts:40-50) ignores CAPTURE_INTERRUPTED, CROSS_ORIGIN_IFRAME_NOT_CAPTURED and SHADOW_DOM_NOT_FULLY_REPRESENTED, so a capture cut short by the 30s budget is labelled completeness=CAPTURED. (c) If GET_SANITIZED_DOM fails, domArtifact returns null (capture.ts:60) and no limitation is recorded although the popup promised a structure copy. (d) PROTECTED_MEDIA_NOT_CAPTURED and DYNAMIC_CONTENT_MAY_BE_INCOMPLETE exist in the schema but the extension never emits them. (e) The sanitizer removes ALL iframes, but only cross-origin ones are disclosed. The server validator does no completeness/limitation coherence check.
findings.observed: Limitations recorded (sometimes) but never projected; completeness can say CAPTURED for an interrupted capture.
findings.expected: Server derives completeness from the limitations + artifact set and projects completeness, limitations, source URL/title into Detail, Report and the package acquisition section.
findings.rootCause: The manifest was designed as a validation input only; no read-model consumes it.
findings.remediation: Persist a bounded projection of the validated manifest (completeness, limitations, mode, tile count, domain) at web-complete; render it in review-workspace/report/package; make deriveCompleteness treat any limitation as PARTIAL and record DOM_SNAPSHOT_MISSING-style omission.
findings.requiredTests: Manifest-builder test: CAPTURE_INTERRUPTED => PARTIAL; integration: a PARTIAL web capture shows its limitations in review-workspace and the package acquisition JSON.

findings.title: Capture state lives only in the popup: reopening the popup during a capture allows a concurrent second capture of the same tab, and a capture whose popup closed never reports its outcome
findings.userImpact: Clicking the page closes the popup; the capture keeps running unseen. Reopening shows enabled buttons; a second click starts another session. Two FULL_PAGE loops scroll the same tab concurrently. After a lost response the popup says 'Nothing was saved' although a record may have sealed.
findings.legalImpact: Concurrent loops interleave scrolls: a tile's recorded scrollOffsetY (taken from its own SCROLL_TO reply) can differ from what captureVisibleTab actually photographed, so the manifest can misdescribe tile positions. Duplicate sealed records of one page.
findings.reproduction: Start 'Capture full page' on a long page, click into the page (popup closes), reopen the popup, click 'Capture full page' again. background.ts:153-166 accepts both PRESERVE messages; no lock, no idempotency key on /v1/capture/direct-sessions.
findings.observed: No in-flight guard in the service worker; no persisted capture status; generic failure line asserts nothing was saved.
findings.expected: A per-tab in-flight lock in the service worker, status persisted in chrome.storage.session and shown on popup reopen, and failure copy that does not assert nothing was saved when the seal outcome is unknown.
findings.rootCause: busy() is popup DOM state; the orchestrator is stateless.
findings.remediation: Hold an in-flight map in the SW (and storage.session), reject/queue duplicates, expose GET_STATUS for the popup, and on unknown outcome tell the user to check the Evidence library.
findings.requiredTests: SW unit test: second PRESERVE for same tab while first running is refused; popup reopen shows running/last result.

findings.title: Extension sign-in dead-ends for a user who is not already signed in to PROOVRA: authorize answers a 401 JSON body in the auth window with no login redirect
findings.userImpact: launchWebAuthFlow shows a raw JSON error page; the user must close it and is told to 'check that pop-ups are allowed', which is not the cause.
findings.reproduction: Signed out of proovra.com (no proovra_session cookie). Click 'Sign in' in the popup. GET /v1/oauth/extension/authorize runs requireAuth, which with no token returns reply.code(401).send(createErrorResponse(UNAUTHORIZED)). Nothing redirects to /login?next=authorize.
findings.observed: Auth window stuck on a 401 JSON payload; popup copy blames pop-ups.
findings.expected: Unauthenticated authorize redirects to the web login with a return URL back to authorize (validated), then completes the code flow.
findings.rootCause: Authorize reuses API-only requireAuth, which is designed for XHR callers.
findings.remediation: Add an HTML-navigation branch on authorize that redirects to the app login with a signed return-to; fix SIGN_IN_FAILED copy.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: authorize without cookie => 302 to login with safe return; with cookie => 302 to chromiumapp redirect.

findings.title: 'Sanitized, secrets cleared' DOM snapshot keeps <meta> CSRF tokens and other non-input secret carriers of the capturing user's session on the captured site
findings.userImpact: The preserved snapshot (shared via packages/reports with third parties) can contain the capturer's live anti-CSRF token for the captured site.
findings.legalImpact: Evidence bundle carries the capturer's session material for a third-party site.
findings.securityImpact: Recipients of the snapshot get e.g. Rails/Laravel/GitHub-style <meta name="csrf-token" content=...> values bound to the capturer's logged-in session; signed URLs in href/src (X-Amz-Signature, ?token=) are also kept.
findings.reproduction: Capture any page that renders <meta name="csrf-token" content="X">. sanitizeDom only removes <meta> when http-equiv=refresh (sanitizer.ts:115-120); name/id token matching applies only to input/textarea (lines 141-153). The serialized snapshot is labelled 'inert, secrets cleared' (content.ts:48).
findings.expected: Clear content of <meta> whose name/property matches the sensitive-token list (csrf, xsrf, token, session, nonce) and record the count; consider stripping query strings with signature/token params.
findings.remediation: Extend shouldClearInputValue-style matching to meta name/property and to data-* attributes with token names; unit-test.
findings.requiredTests: sanitizer.test.mjs: meta csrf-token content cleared; signed URL query neutralised or disclosed.

findings.title: Token expiry is not handled as a sign-in state; 'offline' scope is requested but no refresh exists
findings.userImpact: After 1h (or a 401 mid-capture) the user gets the generic 'could not be completed' line while the popup still shows the signed-in UI.
findings.reproduction: Let the token expire with the popup open, click Capture: background throws a plain Error (not ApiError) => popup shows CAPTURE_FAILED; render() is not re-run. A 401 from any capture call likewise maps to denial=null => generic line.
findings.observed: Auth expiry indistinguishable from a capture fault.
findings.expected: 401/expired => clear token, show signed-out section with 'Your session ended, sign in again'.
findings.rootCause: No auth-state branch in the failure path; scope string advertises offline access that is never implemented.
findings.remediation: Map 401 and missing token to a SIGNED_OUT result; drop 'offline' from the requested scope or implement refresh.
findings.requiredTests: Popup test: PRESERVE result with status 401 renders signed-out.

findings.title: Extension sign-out does not revoke the server token; the token has no sid so per-session revocation cannot reach it
findings.userImpact: After 'Sign out' a copied token keeps working on the capture allowlist for up to an hour.
findings.securityImpact: Bounded by capture.direct scope and 1h TTL; only a user-wide revoke (iat) can kill it.
findings.reproduction: signOut() only removes chrome.storage.session key; token claims include sub/provider/email/authMethod/authAt/scope but no sid.
findings.expected: A revoke endpoint (or sid-bound token) so sign-out and 'sign out other sessions' reach extension tokens.
findings.rootCause: Extension token minted outside the session registry.
findings.remediation: Mint the extension token with a registered session id; add POST /v1/oauth/extension/revoke on the scope allowlist.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: after revoke, capture route answers 401.

findings.title: Extension cannot file a capture to a case, while the UC-1 implementation record states case selection is sent and case-access checked
findings.userImpact: Every web capture lands unassigned; filing to a matter requires a separate trip to the web Evidence library.
findings.reproduction: OpenDirectSessionBody is .strict() with mode/teamId/deviceId only; popup has no case control; scope allowlist excludes /v1/cases/*.
findings.observed: No case attachment path from the extension.
findings.expected: Either an optional caseId on open-session (server case-access checked) with a popup picker, or the doc stops claiming it.
findings.remediation: Add caseId to the session (authorize via canonical case access) and link on seal; or correct the doc.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: open-session with foreign caseId refused (anti-enumeration 404); sealed capture appears under the case.

findings.title: User-facing Direct Web Capture legal page and capture card still claim the session is issued before the capture and that PROOVRA 'participates in' the capture; the extension captures first and the server does not observe capture
findings.userImpact: Readers are told the process order is stronger than it is.
findings.legalImpact: Contradicts the canonical CAPTURE_CLIENT_ATTESTED limitation ('The PROOVRA server did not observe it ... when the capture happened relative to the session ... not independently proven'); a disclosure page for legal professionals asserts an ordering the code does not implement.
findings.reproduction: background.ts: captureFullPage/captureViewport run at lines 48-51, openWebSession only at line 55. The legal page says the extension 'opens a server-issued capture session before the capture begins' and 'produces the bytes under a session that the server issued in advance'.
findings.observed: Ordering claim remediated in the shared acquisition statement (ET-DC-02) but left in the legal page and card copy.
findings.expected: Copy matches the client-attested tier: capture happens in the browser, then is submitted in a server-issued session; server verifies bytes received, not the capture.
findings.rootCause: ET-DC-02 fix covered the shared statement only.
findings.remediation: Rewrite sections 1-2 of direct-web-capture.md and the card body; add these files to the claim-blocklist guard.
findings.requiredTests: Copy guard asserting 'before the capture'/'in advance'/'participates in the capture' absent from web-capture surfaces.

findings.title: Web Finish & Sign is not resumable: the draft is marked FINALIZED when the record is reserved, a mid-upload failure leaves items stuck 'uploading', and retry mints a second Evidence record
findings.userImpact: After a network/5xx/4xx failure on any file, retry creates a new record and re-uploads every file; the first record is orphaned until swept; failed items show as still uploading (no 'Retry needed'), cannot be removed with 'Remove pending items', and the draft disappears from 'unfinished sessions' because the server already moved it to FINALIZED.
findings.legalImpact: Custody/audit shows the draft FINALIZED into an evidence id that never sealed; reload recovery of a failed session is impossible.
findings.reproduction: Stage 3 files, block the S3 host for file 2, click Review & Sign. POST /v1/evidence (line 671, captureSessionId=draft) => server flips draft DRAFT->FINALIZED with finalizedEvidenceId (evidence.routes.ts:5711-5740). File 2 PUT fails (3 transient attempts) => throw (888) => catch (944-990) sets page error but never resets item.uploading/uploadProgress. Click again: a new POST /v1/evidence (no idempotency key, evidenceId not retained) creates record #2.
findings.observed: Non-idempotent finalize; draft finalized pre-upload; stale item state.
findings.expected: Draft moves to FINALIZED only at /complete; the orchestrator retains evidenceId and resumes missing parts on retry (parts route is RETURN_EXISTING idempotent); failed items marked error.
findings.rootCause: Finalize treated as one-shot; draft transition bound to create instead of seal.
findings.remediation: Move the draft FINALIZED transition to completeEvidence; keep evidenceId in orchestrator/draft and resume; reset per-item state in catch.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: create with captureSessionId leaves draft DRAFT until complete; web hook test: second finalize after a part failure reuses the evidenceId.

findings.title: Capture page drops its leave-page and workspace-switch guards exactly while uploading/finalizing
findings.userImpact: Closing the tab or switching workspace mid-upload gives no warning; the upload is abandoned silently.
findings.reproduction: hasStagedMaterials = sessionItems.length > 0 && !busy; useDirtyWork(sessionItems.length > 0 && !busy). busy is true for the whole finalize.
findings.observed: Guards off during the only window where leaving loses in-flight work.
findings.expected: Guard while busy too (success path clears items before router.push, so no false prompt).
findings.requiredTests: Render test: beforeunload handler prevents default while busy.

findings.title: Public intake page: every reload opens a fresh intake session and the page never re-lists uploaded parts, so reload discards the contributor's progress
findings.userImpact: A contributor who reloads (or whose mobile browser evicts the tab) must redo consent and re-upload everything; the earlier uploads sit in an abandoned session. No beforeunload warning exists on this page.
findings.legalImpact: Orphaned partial submissions in abandoned sessions; contributor may believe files were sent.
findings.reproduction: Open /intake/<token>, accept consent, upload 2 files, reload. GET /v1/external-intake/:token always calls openIntakeSession (create) ; the external session projection has no parts; the page initialises parts=[] and nextIndex=parts.length.
findings.observed: No session resumption; uploaded parts invisible.
findings.expected: Resume the contributor's open session (e.g. session id in sessionStorage presented back to the token route) and list its parts.
findings.rootCause: Session-per-redemption design with no client-held session handle.
findings.remediation: Accept an optional session handle on GET, return the open session with its parts; add beforeunload guard while parts are staged.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: GET with valid handle returns the same session + parts; web test: reload restores list.

findings.title: Home 'Review submissions' priority links to /evidence-requests, a route with no page (404)
findings.userImpact: The primary call to action for reviewing intake submissions lands on Page Not Found.
findings.legalImpact: External evidence awaiting review is harder to reach.
findings.reproduction: Have >=1 submission awaiting review; Home renders 'Review submissions' => href '/evidence-requests?status=RESPONSE_RECEIVED,UNDER_REVIEW'. app/(app)/evidence-requests contains only [id]/; no next.config.js redirect. The route registry itself records 'root list page does not exist'.
findings.expected: Link to the existing review surface (e.g. review queues evidence-request queue) or ship the list page.
findings.rootCause: Home CTA not reconciled with the registry's own note.
findings.remediation: Point href at /review/queues evidence-request queue (apps/web/app/(app)/review/queues/_evidence-request-queue.tsx) and add a route-integrity test for Home hrefs.
findings.requiredTests: Route-integrity test: every home-view-model href resolves to a page or redirect.

findings.title: After seal, the capture page reports a failed/blocked report generation as 'still generating'
findings.userImpact: A report that failed or is gated is presented as pending.
findings.reproduction: pollArtifacts only checks status.report.available and swallows errors; after 8 polls returns false => toast 'Verification artifacts are still generating' even when /artifacts/status reports a blocked/failed state (evidence.routes.ts:10903 comment documents blocked vs pending vs failed).
findings.expected: Branch on the status' failed/blocked state.
findings.requiredTests: Hook test with a failed report status.

findings.title: Drag-and-drop failure puts the raw browser exception message on screen, bypassing toSafeUserError
findings.userImpact: Users can see internal DOMException text.
findings.reproduction: filesFromDataTransfer rejects (e.g. entry read NotFoundError) => setError(err.message).
findings.expected: toSafeUserError / fixed copy per the safe-feedback rule.
findings.remediation: Use toSafeUserError(err, {message: 'Dropped files or folder could not be added.'}).
